newsitem.title: USA: Applied says Novellus suit meritless.
newsitem.headline: Applied says Novellus suit meritless.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc said Tuesday that a patent infringement suit filed against it by Novellus Systems Inc last week is without merit.

Novellus is accusing Applied Materials of infringing its patents by making, using and selling Endura and Centura physical vapor deposition systems. Novellus said it acquired the patents from Varian Associates Inc with the acquisition of Varian's Thin Film Systems business.
Applied said it filed suit against Varian June 13, claiming infringement of four of its patents relating to physical vapor deposition technologies.

"Applied's dispute is with Varian's infringement of Applied's patented rights, which had been raised with Varian some time ago," Applied said Tuesday, adding that it plans to vigorously defend against the suit by Novellus.
